title: open/1: the text the Drawing editor reads for a structure file
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli mol open`; `text` is the file decoded as UTF-8 (binary CDX as base64), `changes` lists each change made to it, in this order: `charset` (the file was UTF-16 or 8-bit text) then `empty` (attributes with an empty value dropped from the CDXML start tags). Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/chem/structure_file.rs.
